title: eBay unveils collection of cars inspired by gaming's most iconic rides
summary: The eBay Most Wanted Collection will debut at SEMA, with its four gaming-inspired vehicles going up for auction during the first marquee vehicle livestream on eBay Live.
body_markdown:
**SAN JOSE, October 29, 2026** — Today, eBay launched the eBay Most Wanted Collection, a fleet of four cars inspired by some of gaming culture's most recognizable rides. Marking the introduction of vehicles accessible on eBay Live, the collection will debut at the 2026 SEMA Show in Las Vegas on Thursday, November 5, during the first marquee vehicle auction, co-hosted by actor and automotive enthusiast Sung Kang and automotive creator Hertrech “Hert” Eugene Jr. Fans can tune into eBay’s livestream shopping experience to bid on each vehicle starting at just $6, with 100% of proceeds benefiting Susan G. Komen.


Gaming has long given enthusiasts the chance to drive, collect and customize the dream cars they might never otherwise experience in real life, building virtual garages along the way. The eBay Most Wanted Collection brings that opportunity to life with four vehicles, sourced on eBay, with select cars customized using parts and accessories found on the marketplace, giving enthusiasts the chance to discover, bid on and ultimately own the cars they've always imagined driving.


The eBay Most Wanted Collection includes:


- The South Beach Supercar – **2022 Chevrolet Corvette C8**
- The Street Icon – **2006 Dodge Viper**
- The Classic Getaway – **1992 BMW 325i Convertible**
- The Hot Pink Hi-riser – **1975 Chevrolet Nova**


“For 30 years, eBay has helped automotive enthusiasts find their dream vehicles and the parts to make them their own,” said Jesse Kiefer, Vice President and General Manager, eBay Live. “The eBay Most Wanted Collection brings that passion to life in a new way, showcasing what’s possible through the eBay marketplace while giving fans a fun new way to discover and bid on these cars on eBay Live. It’s an exciting next step in how we’re bringing enthusiasts closer to the cars and communities they love.”


### eBay Most Wanted Collection Auction on eBay Live at SEMA


On November 5 at 12 p.m. PT, fans can tune into eBay Live for a front-row seat as the four vehicles go up for auction, with bidding starting at just $6 each.


Co-hosts Sung Kang and automotive creator Hertrech “Hert” Eugene Jr. will bring their shared passion for car culture to the livestream, taking viewers behind the vehicles, sharing the stories and inspiration behind the collection and interacting with fans as the bidding unfolds.


Sung Kang (pictured) and Hertrech “Hert” Eugene Jr. will co-host the eBay Most Wanted auction on eBay Live.


“For me, cars have always been about more than just driving, they’re about the friendships and community you build along the way,” said Sung Kang. “eBay has been part of that journey for years, helping me find the right parts and connect with sellers who share that same passion. With the eBay Most Wanted Collection, we’re giving fans the chance to own cars they’ve dreamed about, with eBay Live bringing everyone together to experience the auction in real time. And knowing that 100% of proceeds will benefit Susan G. Komen, a cause close to my heart, makes it even more meaningful.”


Winning bidders will complete their eBay Live vehicle purchases through eBay Secure Purchase, powered by Caramel Dealer Services, LLC, an eBay subsidiary. The service helps simplify payment, paperwork and delivery, with eligible transactions qualifying for up to $500,000 in purchase protection, subject to applicable terms.


The vehicles will be offered through Matchfire, with 100% of proceeds from the auctions benefiting Susan G. Komen, giving fans an opportunity to support an important cause while bidding on the collection.


Fans can preview the eBay Most Wanted Collection, explore each of the four vehicles and set a reminder to tune in to eBay Live on November 5 at 12 p.m. PT at[ebay.com/mostwanted](http://ebay.com/mostwanted) .


**About eBay Live**


eBay has long been a trusted destination for fans to buy and sell authentic items tied to the moments that define sports, style and pop culture, and eBay Live brings fans even closer to the action. Offering unrivaled inventory, trusted sellers, and real-time community interaction, eBay’s live shopping experience continues to grow.


For more information and to explore upcoming eBay Live programming, visit[www.ebay.com/eBayLive](http://www.ebay.com/eBayLive/)
